solutionSql:
DELETE FROM invoices
WHERE shipment_id IN (SELECT id FROM shipments WHERE status = 'cancelled');

sampleChecks.Invoices and cancelled-shipment invoices: Before: 205 invoices, 55 for cancelled shipments. After: 150 invoices, 0 for cancelled shipments. The DELETE removed 55.

notes: Single DELETE with an IN subquery. No table references invoices, so no cascade issue arises.
